RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: Render only exact_* strings, no invented labels or results.
White canvas and boxes with colored borders only.
Every major panel has a meaningful visual anchor, no empty grids replacing content.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning icons, NO 3D rendering, no gradients, no shadows.
Arrows never cross text. Dashed return terminates at X★, not X.
No geographic border map; terrain profile is conceptual.
No scores, measured data, causal claims beyond supplied text.
Local-process labels explain background mechanisms, not additional dynamic predictors; only terrain and land surface condition tag feeds reconstruction.
